svg.title: Architecture: plan, own resources, execute, publish
svg.desc: The runner reads the pinned models.csv, runs preflight and resume checks and routes oversized models to later row-block jobs. The dispatcher owns GPU reservations, process groups and CPU thread budgets and reloads live policy on SIGHUP. Each isolated worker loads one model, computes spectra on GPU threads while a CPU sidecar fingerprints the same weights, and publishes one package. A supervisor watches heartbeat, stage time, RAM and cache. After the worker's process group exits, its private cache is removed and its GPUs return to the pool. An unconfirmed exit keeps the cache and reservation and stops new dispatch.
